name: Squill | Write Freely
tagline: A writing assistant that helps students draft scholarship and statement-of-purpose essays without writing them for them.
problem: Personal statements are the most daunting part of scholarship applications, and the team cites large sums of aid going unclaimed.
solution: Multi-agent questioning helps students discover what to say, with live tracking, personal-data redaction and verification steps, then exports to a word processor.
demo_moment: Team-described: answer guided questions and see your own ideas shaped into a draft outline.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Foresters: The Multi-Agent Mind” among 160 submissions.
Positions AI as a thinking partner, not a ghostwriter.
Adds redaction and verification steps for responsible use.

lessons: Saying what the AI will not do can be the differentiator.
